scope: Status meaning and stale readout refusal
Checkpoint binding, trusted-array restore validation and quarantine
Full/compact/replay failure recording and survivor checkpoint isolation
D2/D7 claim scope; no physical safety or coverage certification

findings.finding: configuration_id hashes calibration config only; status does not bind numerical representation, effective refresh cadence or clock despite specification claiming configuration binding. H5 and H7 publications with the same source/model/calibration and prefix have identical complete status identities. Different H7 refresh cadences also have identical identities.

counterexample.construction: TangentBackend versus H7Backend, same source/model/calibration, rate35, refresh17s; additionally H7Backend refresh1000s

findings.impact: A copied status alone cannot distinguish these estimator configurations. Authorization remains unresolved, and restore separately checks cadence and array shapes, so this is an identity-contract gap rather than a demonstrated physical authorization or checkpoint bypass.
findings.requested_change: Bind versioned backend/representation descriptors, effective refresh interval and clock alongside calibration configuration; add distinguishing-identity regression tests.
findings.disposition: Parent accepted finding and plans repair; substantive change requires independent re-review.

positive_observations: Current readout refuses quarantine; diagnostic publication explicitly retains unavailable/unresolved status and separate consumed/published counts.
Native consumption is consulted after exceptions and guarded advance prevents a consumed block from being retried through the quarantined object.

Trusted restore checks schema, identity, counters, cadence, shapes/finiteness and chronology, then re-queries restored native state and checks exact saved carrier and anchor before clearing quarantine.
Compact checkpoints serialize only active aligned arms; failed arm diagnostic result recording uses last_message; dedicated campaign tests cover survivor replay.
Specification clearly excludes concurrent access, arbitrary coherent tampering, physical coverage, autonomous recovery deadlines and target readiness.
limitations: No exhaustive fault-path proof or independent physical/numerical qualification.
No source-code optimization or production edits performed by reviewer.
Successful-prefix parity receipt inspected; parity suite not independently rerun.
Campaign exception handlers catch selected classes; arbitrary Exceptions still quarantine backend but are not all promised to produce completed recording artifacts.
